pull: Twelve managers, twenty-three rounds, 276 picks, and a robot made 84 of them.
desk: The inaugural draft is in the books: twelve managers, twenty-three rounds, 276 picks, and 84 of them made by a robot. Painty69 promised to positive and kind the whole thing, made his last real pick in round 6, and let the CPU take the remaining seventeen rounds, which is the kindest thing anyone did all night. Johnny4Skins matched him at 18 autopicks by taking Ja'Marr Chase and Lamar Jackson and then, apparently, going to dinner. The robot made good use of the time: Jalen Hurts, A.J. Brown, Tyler Warren, Kyren Williams, Brian Thomas and DK Metcalf all landed on Johnny4Skins's roster without a single human opinion. The best manager in the league may be the one who has none.

Darkspaces, the commissioner, cut the draft timer to one minute, drafted thirteen receivers and three running backs, gave twenty-three of his players nicknames, and then told the room he had put on a hat and shaved his cock to look bigger after Painty69 hurt his feelings. Hades9mm asked for proof. CMac91 said it works. The desk did not ask for details and received them anyway.

The wire opened before the confetti landed. YesChef23 cut Terrance Ferguson and Ollie Gordon, two players he drafted, and both were claimed in the first waiver run: Ferguson by Darkspaces for $101, Gordon by Zygon for $2. Darkspaces then listed Achane, Swift, Collins and four more on the block, Hades9mm listed Kittle and Pacheco, and StealingGas listed Quentin Johnston. Nothing has traded yet. Everything has been priced.

Week 1 is set. Hades9mm carries the league's highest projection at 149.97, Zygon and Johnny4Skins project to a dead heat, and the commissioner plays the man who promised to be kind. The desk has ranked all twelve rosters below. Complaints may be filed in the draft chat, which is where everyone does their best work.

hero.text: Every one of his 23 picks was his own. Daniels and Goff cover the superflex, St. Brown, London and Adams run the receiver room, Henry and Skattebo carry the backfield, and Kittle and Kelce give him tight ends to sell. It is the only roster in the league that is balanced, hand-built, and not under construction.
hero.desk: He opened the draft with a single 'no' and closed it with 'send pic to prove.' The arc writes itself.

zero.text: Gibbs, McCaffrey, Barkley, Tate and Kraft were his own work. After round 6 the CPU took 17 straight picks for him, and the feed has since shown him free-agent-moving Sarratt, Aiyuk and Klubnik, three of the robot's choices. Elite top end, a robot bottom, and a manager who left in the middle.
zero.desk: He promised to positive and kind the draft. He was kind to the clock by disappearing.

drama.p: Painty69 and YesChef23 traded shots, StealingGas declared himself offended too and offered to 'fucking holler,' and Darkspaces, who is the commissioner, announced he had put on a hat and shaved his cock to look bigger after his feelings got hurt. Hades9mm asked for photographic proof and followed up with 'no balls.' CMac91 closed the matter with 'it works...'
drama.desk: A league commissioner has disclosed his grooming routine in the same chat that sets the rules. The desk considers this the most transparent governance in dynasty football.

drama.h: The Restaurant Arc: YesChef23 vs Painty69
drama.p: YesChef23 opened the draft chat fighting an Uber Eats driver who stole a customer's order ('fucking cocksucker') while also talking shit to Painty69 and cursing the 'turtle ass drafters.' Painty69 fired back: 'Stop looking at baseball cards and worry about your restaurant. The blind lead the blind it seems.' YesChef23: 'The fuck are you talking about. I won't go there in this chat.' Painty69 then called it 'good fun' and said 'my bad.' Nobody believed him.
drama.desk: 'I won't go there in this chat' is the most ominous sentence of the draft. It implies another chat. The desk would like to be added.

drama.h: Autopick Bowl: Painty69 and Johnny4Skins, 18 Each
drama.p: The commissioner dropped the timer to one minute and a lot of the room left. The CPU made 84 of the 276 picks, about 30 percent of the draft. Painty69 and Johnny4Skins tied for the lead with 18, fumbduckdumbfuck made 14, and Sarge71 and CMac91 made 12 each. CMac91 asked in round 5 whether there were 'seriously 23 rounds,' played through round 11, and then let the robot draft Travis Hunter, whom Sleeper lists as a defensive back in a league with no DB slot. YesChef23 'thought about just taking defenses the rest of the way' and settled for two.
drama.desk: 'Holy hell' was the right reaction. CMac91 just declined to have it twelve more times.

drama.h: Win Now, Figure It Out Later
drama.p: Painty69 took McCaffrey and Barkley back to back and YesChef23 noted that he was 'drafting all the injury prone dudes.' StealingGas read the room: 'all the old heads... win now figure it out later.' YesChef23 later advised against drafting Aaron Rodgers 'or anyone else that probably going to retire until way later,' and Darkspaces replied 'fuck gonna have to revise my strategy.' Rodgers then turned up as an autopick on fumbduckdumbfuck and was free-agent-moved two days later.
drama.desk: The league's draft philosophy is a man in a hat saying 'one more year, king' about a quarterback who is not his.

drama.p: Painty69 opened with 'Hades is in this league.' Hades9mm: 'no.' Painty69: 'Hades, I'm glad you're here. You're a good homie.' Hades9mm: 'for real... I'm taking your name of the list.' Johnny4Skins, to the room: 'Painter, what is Hades name?' Nobody answered. Hades9mm then built the best roster in the league without a single autopick.
drama.desk: A man who began with 'no' ended with 'send pic to prove.' The desk is invested in the character development.

trades.note: Hypothetical only. Nothing has traded, everything has been listed, and the commissioner alone has seven players on the block. These are the deals the desk would like to see someone make.

items.ay: Moves a volatile young back and a tight end he nicknamed 'Jake From State Farm' for two proven veterans at the same spots, and clears roster room for more nicknames.
items.by: Hades9mm already has Henry, Skattebo and Dowdle. Achane is the upside swing at running back and the Fergusons are cheaper than the Kittles.
items.desk: Two fire sales in one trade. Nobody involved is capable of calling it a fire sale.

items.ay: Darkspaces has Maye, Mendoza and Simpson at quarterback. Stafford is the sell-high veteran he nicknamed 'One More Year, King.'
items.by: fumbduckdumbfuck's superflex room is Dak Prescott and whatever the robot found in rounds 10 through 23. A starting quarterback is the cheapest upgrade in his lineup.
items.desk: The nickname is the pitch. 'One more year' is also the contract.

items.ay: Sells a veteran WR1 and takes back a rookie WR1 plus a pick, which is the move of a man who has 13 receivers and no fear.
items.by: Painty69's receivers are Tate and the robot's picks. Collins is a real WR1 for a roster built around three elite running backs and a win-now clock.
items.desk: Selling your best receiver to the man you play in Week 1 is either confidence or paperwork.

block.desk: Seven players listed, twenty-three nicknames assigned, one commissioner. Nothing has sold, because the asking price is still a feeling.
Two veterans listed while his lineup is still the league's best on paper. Either a plan or a dare.
One listing, no urgency, and a team named Future Therapy Bills.

waivers.note: $2 for a running back another manager cut. The cheapest claim of the dynasty so far and the best value on the board.
$101 for a tight end YesChef23 cut. 'They call me the LA Rams because the cap doesn't exist.' The cap is $500, and he has now spent a fifth of it.
Waller for free after cutting the tight end he drafted. The desk respects the dedication to the position, if not the order of operations.
Johnson for free as the backfield committee begins to assemble itself from spare parts.

desk.Darkspaces: Ferguson for $101, the Titans defense, and Kevin Coleman for nothing. He now owns two Fergusons and one of them is on the block. The commissioner has spent a fifth of his FAAB before a single snap.
desk.Zygon: Ollie Gordon for $2 and Barion Brown for free. The IR Predictor does what the name says: finds the injured and the discarded before anyone else notices.
desk.YesChef23: Waller for free after cutting Terrance Ferguson, Ollie Gordon and Tyreek Hill, whom the board lists with no team. Two of the three were claimed before the waiver run finished. The Uber Eats refund took longer.
desk.StealingGas: Holani and Roschon Johnson for the backfield, Vele and Bryce Lance for the receiver room, all free. Four moves, $0, and the first RB committee in the league.

draft.why: Daniels and Goff cover the superflex, St. Brown, London and Adams give him the receiver room, Henry and Skattebo carry the backfield, and Kittle and Kelce are the tight ends. Zero autopicks across 23 rounds.
draft.risk: Henry, Adams, Kittle and Kelce are all veterans, and half the tight end room is already on the trade block.
draft.desk: The desk's best roster and the league's most improved chat presence.

draft.why: Josh Allen and Justin Herbert is the best quarterback pair in the league, and Olave, McConkey and Flowers form a real receiver room. Only four autopicks.
draft.risk: The backfield is Irving, Brooks and Dobbins, a position group that needs health, a miracle, or a trade.
draft.desk: He wins the superflex before anyone else logs in. The desk recommends he never sell a quarterback.

draft.why: Chase and Lamar Jackson were his own picks. Hurts, A.J. Brown, Tyler Warren, Kyren Williams, Brian Thomas and DK Metcalf were the CPU's, and none of them is a joke.
draft.risk: Eighteen autopicks means nobody chose the depth, and a robot cannot read an injury report.
draft.desk: The strategy is to be absent and let the machine hold the room. So far it is working.

draft.why: Gibbs, McCaffrey and Barkley is the best running back trio in the league, Burrow is a top-tier quarterback, and Carnell Tate is a rookie WR1.
draft.risk: McCaffrey and Barkley are the injury-prone dudes YesChef23 named, and everything below Tate in the receiver room is a CPU decision.
draft.desk: Three elite backs and a draft room he left in round 7.

draft.why: Mahomes, Smith-Njigba, McBride and Higgins make a quality core, and with five quarterbacks drafted he has the deepest superflex room in the league.
draft.risk: Chase Brown and Kenneth Walker are the running backs, and the team name is IR Predictor, which is either a forecast or a confession.
draft.desk: Mahomes plus four backups is a position of strength. It is also a medical chart.

draft.why: Bowers at 1.12, Jeanty at 2.01 and Taylor at 3.01 is a three-pick run most teams cannot match, with Rice, DeVonta Smith and Makai Lemon to follow.
draft.risk: Dak Prescott is the quarterback, and everything behind him came from fourteen straight autopicks. In a superflex league that is a real hole.
draft.desk: A contender at every position except the one the format requires him to start twice.

draft.why: Jefferson at 1.05, Hampton at 2.08, Purdy, Loveland and Judkins make a complete lineup, with eight running backs and nine receivers drafted and only two autopicks.
draft.risk: The quarterback room is Purdy, Willis and Drew Allar, which is safe and has no ceiling.
draft.desk: Snipe58 said nothing for 23 rounds and drafted like he read the manual. The desk respects it and does not trust it.

draft.why: Maye is the franchise quarterback, Mendoza and Stafford are the insurance, and Collins, Odunze, Egbuka and Kupp lead the receiver room. He made every pick himself.
draft.risk: Three running backs total, two of whom are on the block, and seven listed players is a lineup in motion.
draft.desk: Twenty-three nicknames and three running backs. The priorities are visible.

draft.why: Nacua at 1.08 and Nabers at 2.05 are two real WR1s, with Wilson and Tyson behind them and Lawrence, Ward and Murray in the superflex room.
draft.risk: The backfield is Henderson, Tuten and a pile of waiver adds, and Quentin Johnston is already on the block.
draft.desk: He named the team Future Therapy Bills. The desk notes the name arrived before the standings did.

draft.why: Caleb Williams at 1.10, Love at 2.03, Pickens, Burden and Price make a young core, and every pick was hand-made.
draft.risk: He cut Terrance Ferguson and Ollie Gordon, who were claimed by Darkspaces and Zygon in the first waiver run. The cuts look like gifts.
draft.desk: The man who thought about taking defenses the rest of the way is exactly one move from doing it.

draft.why: Cook, Lamb, Nix and Hall are as good a top four as anyone in the bottom half of the board, and he picked the first eleven rounds himself.
draft.risk: From round 12 the CPU drafted Travis Hunter, a defensive back he cannot start, plus twelve autopicks of depth.
draft.desk: He asked if there were seriously 23 rounds. There were. He stayed for 11.

draft.why: Bijan Robinson at 1.04 is a top-three dynasty asset, and Dart and Darnold give him a workable superflex pair, with McMillan and Waddle at receiver.
draft.risk: The CPU took the last twelve picks and handed him five tight ends, in a format that starts one.
draft.desk: Five tight ends and a Bijan. The desk is not asking, only noting.

pre.desk: The two teams most likely to deny this is a rivalry. Hades9mm has the better chat arc.

pre.lb: The quarterback is Dak Prescott and a robot. That is the whole sentence.

pre.desk: YesChef23 cut two players he drafted, and Darkspaces and Zygon claimed both. The refund on the Uber Eats order took longer.

pre.mb: Chase and Lamar Jackson are the two best players on the field. Hurts at SUPERFLEX is the robot's gift.
pre.la: Chase Brown and Walker are the running backs. A dud at either is a big drop.
pre.lb: Everything below Chase and the quarterbacks was chosen by a robot that is not permitted to complain.
pre.edge: A dead heat. Zygon has the biggest name at quarterback, Johnny4Skins has two quarterbacks and a bench the robot built.
pre.desk: Zygon's team name is IR Predictor, a forecast or a confession. Johnny4Skins's team name is a robot.

motw.ma: Maye is the QB1 and the wide receivers carry the lineup. Achane is the only back who is not a committee.
motw.mb: Gibbs, McCaffrey and Barkley are the lineup and the rest is the robot. Start the backs and pray.
motw.la: Three running backs on the roster. If Achane and Swift are the starters, the flex is a receiver and the roster is a travel agency.
motw.lb: Receiver depth is the robot's: Evans, Boston, Sutton. If Tate stalls, so does the offense.
motw.edge: Painty69 by two points on the projection, Darkspaces on the chat. The desk goes with the running backs.
motw.desk: The commissioner draws the man who promised to be positive and kind and left after round 6. The desk expects neither to carry over to Week 1.
motw.stakes: The commissioner shaved for confidence and shortened the draft clock, and Painty69 hurt his feelings and left after round 6. Dynasty stakes: Darkspaces built a 13-receiver roster around Maye and a block full of veterans he is happy to sell. Painty69 built Gibbs, McCaffrey and Barkley on win-now assets and let a robot do the rest. A Darkspaces win says the receiver room works and the block is a negotiating position. A Painty69 win says three elite backs is a roster and the commissioner's is a mood.

Seven players on the block means a lineup in flux

motw.verdict: Projection edge to Painty69, because three elite backs beat a receiver room when the backs are healthy. Darkspaces has the deeper quarterbacks and the better chat. The desk goes Painty69 by a field goal and will accept screenshots to the contrary.

paras: The draft is over, the nicknames are set, the block is open, and the CPU is the busiest manager in the league. Hades9mm is the desk's best roster because it was built by hand and it has a quarterback. Johnny4Skins is third on the board and first on efficiency, since the robot did the work and cannot be argued with.

The strategic story is the superflex. Every lineup starts two quarterbacks and the quarterback rooms are lopsided: C33DeezNutzz owns Josh Allen and Justin Herbert, Johnny4Skins owns Lamar Jackson and Jalen Hurts, Darkspaces owns four, and fumbduckdumbfuck owns Dak Prescott next to whatever the robot found. The trade market will start there. Running back is the second pressure point. Painty69 has three elite backs, and StealingGas and Darkspaces are both going to start receivers at flex because they have to.

Next up: Week 1. Hades9mm has the highest projection in the league at 149.97, Zygon and Johnny4Skins are a dead heat, and the commissioner plays the man who promised to be kind. Send in your best takes, and remember that every cut player is a free agent until someone else needs him.
